title: Backend: Integrate custom routing service for Dispatcher & Merchant Dashboard
description: Implemented a feature flag to switch between Google Maps and a custom Go-based routing service for distance and duration calculations. Configured environment variables and coordinate swapping for OSRM compatibility.

title: Backend: Dockerize Go routing service
description: Created a multi-stage Dockerfile using golang:alpine for building and alpine for runtime to minimize image size. Added a docker-compose.yml file to orchestrate the service with environment variable support.

title: Backend: Implement OSRM Table API and integrate into find_closest_zone
description: Extended the Go routing service with support for the OSRM Distance Table API. Integrated this into the Python backend's find_closest_zone function with a feature flag, enabling more efficient road-distance based zone identification without relying on Google Maps.

title: Backend: Enable sandbox simulation for rider wallet withdrawals
description: Enabled simulated processing for independent rider bank withdrawals in sandbox mode without invoking external banking gateways. This ensures testing and staging environments can test end-to-end withdrawal flows reliably while preserving full double-entry ledger tracking.

title: Backend: Add transaction PIN authorization for rider wallet withdrawals
description: Implemented secure transaction PIN management for riders, allowing riders to configure, update, and pre-verify a 4-digit PIN. The transaction PIN is now strictly required to authorize all wallet withdrawal requests.
